description: Add money to the account. method apple_pay or card: returns the checkout link for the provider gdex.pro uses (Meld) and the exact steps (receive USDC on the given network, paste the shown GDEX wallet address); the provider shows the real charge, fees and minimum. method crypto: returns the deposit address, network and token. Either way returns a funding operation: follow it with gdex_operation; it reports credited only when USDC is in the wallet, and a pending funding is resumed instead of starting a second payment. Funding never authorizes a trade.

amountUsd.description: What the user wants to pay, in USD (shown in the steps; the provider sets the final charge)

chain.description: Where the USDC should land (default base). Pick the chain of the trade the user wants.

newPayment.description: Only when the user explicitly wants a second payment while one is pending

name: gdex_add_funds
